svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of pcode-emulator-rs: llvm-readobj reads an i386 ELF, Sleigh lifts its code to P-code, and the emulator interprets each op over register, unique and ram spaces. Three instructions of fib(10) run as 17 P-code ops: mov loads n = 10 into EAX, cmp sets five flags through twelve ops, and jge branches to 0x804975F.
svg.text: pcode-emulator-rs — x86 by way of Ghidra's P-code
Sleigh lifts each machine instruction into P-code ops; the emulator interprets those ops over sparse byte spaces.
every x86 flag is its own op.

g.text: wrote [9C, CB, FF, FF] to unique:6600+4
wrote [9C, CB, FF, FF] to unique:6600+4

svg.text: llvm-readobj finds .text and the fib symbol; Sleigh lifts every instruction to P-code before anything runs …
… mov is three ops: add the offset, load n from ram, copy it into EAX …
… cmp is twelve: the subtraction once, then each flag computed by its own match arm …
… and jge compares OF with SF, then CBranch returns PCodeControl::Branch.
n = 10 ≥ 2, so the emulator jumps to 0x804975F and keeps walking fib's P-code.
